record.material_as_written: Rb2 Ti2 O5 (RTO) single crystal, hydrated, conductivity along b
record.synthesis_method: solid-state reaction (TiO2 and RbNO3 pressed into pellet and heated in furnace, then slow cooling)
record.evidence_quote: super-ionic conductivity along ⃗b reaching 3 mS/cm at room temperature after hydration
record.notes: Mobile species is protons (proton conduction proposed), so mobile_ion set to 'other'. Value is for the crystal after ~10 h air exposure per Results section ('reaching 3 mS/cm along ⃗b after 10 h'). Measured on a 2-electrode Au-electrode setup in resin-embedded crystal; bulk resistance used.

record.material_as_written: Rb2 Ti2 O5 (RTO) single crystal, conductivity along b after 1 h exposure
record.synthesis_method: solid-state reaction (TiO2 and RbNO3 pressed into pellet and heated in furnace, then slow cooling)
record.evidence_quote: the highest conductivity is along ⃗b with 0.28 mS/cm after 1 h of exposure time to the atmosphere
record.notes: Hydration state is 1 h of laboratory-air exposure. Measurement temperature not stated for this value (room temperature is implied by the paper's discussion but not given here). Value derived from bulk resistance in Nyquist fit.

record.material_as_written: Rb2 Ti2 O5 (RTO) single crystal, conductivity along c after 10 h exposure
record.synthesis_method: solid-state reaction (TiO2 and RbNO3 pressed into pellet and heated in furnace, then slow cooling)
record.evidence_quote: which is more than two orders of magnitude than that along ⃗c, with a conductivity of 0.006 mS/cm
record.notes: Value is along c, quoted as the comparison point for the 1 h b-axis value; the paper's Figure 6 caption refers to the 10 h exposure for the anisotropy, so the exposure time for this value is not explicitly confirmed. Measurement temperature not stated.
